mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever felt like you're running a race that never really ends? With endless to-do lists and constant pings from your phone, it’s all too easy to feel pulled in every direction—leaving almost no space for the things that really light you up. Imagine what it would be like to hit pause, even just for a moment, and take back control of your day. That's exactly the journey we’re about to take together, inspired by Jake Knapp’s book, Make Time: How to Focus on What Matters Every Day. Instead of letting life’s noise drown out what’s important, we’ll explore how small, intentional choices can help you reclaim your time—and your attention. We’ll look at practical, doable strategies to break free from the default of constant distraction, so you can focus on what truly matters most, whether it’s creative projects, relationships, or your own well-being. Together, we’re going to discover how to shift from just reacting to everything around us, to living with more purpose and clarity. Are you ready? Let’s dive in and start carving out time for what matters—one small step at a time.
